task.summary: Default task

Refactored attribute initialization in `AuraBaseCharacter` by replacing separate primary and vital attribute methods with a unified `InitializeDefaultAttributes` method, updated related gameplay effect application logic.

Introduced `AuraCombatInterface` and refactored `EnemyInterface` to `AuraEnemyInterface` for consistency. Added player level functionality across Player and Enemy characters, along with replication setup in `AuraPlayerState`.

Added `AuraMMC_MaxHealth` and `AuraMMC_MaxMana` classes to calculate maximum health and mana based on attributes and player level. Updated `AuraBaseCharacter` to include the source object in gameplay effect context.

Refactored `AuraMMC_MaxHealth` and `AuraMMC_MaxMana` into a unified `AuraMMC_Base` class to streamline maximum attribute calculations. Simplified calculation logic with extensible coefficient and operation support.

Added new gameplay calculation assets for various attributes (e.g., Armor, Critical Hit Chance) and removed outdated files related to `AuraMMC_MaxHealth` and `AuraMMC_MaxMana` calculations. Updated project configuration to reflect changes.
Cleaned up workspace file and removed outdated task entries to improve project configuration.
Added `.idea` project configuration files for version control and IDE-specific settings.
Updated `.idea/workspace.xml` to reflect changes in version control tracking and project configuration, including updated highlighting settings and cleaned up task entries.

Refactored attribute initialization in `AuraBaseCharacter` to prioritize attribute application order: Primary, Secondary, and Vital. Updated related gameplay effect logic and replaced `DefaultAttributeEffectsMap` with distinct attribute arrays.
Refactored `AuraBaseCharacter` to use uniform initialization for gameplay effect context and outgoing spec handles.
Refactored `InitializeDefaultAttributes` to ensure server-only execution for Player and Enemy characters, improving replication consistency.
Added server-only execution for initial widget controller value broadcast in `AuraHUD` to improve replication consistency.
Updated `.idea/workspace.xml` to track new blueprint files (`BP_AuraCharacter`, `GE_Aura_Default_Attributes_Vital`) and reflect changes in highlighting settings and task entries.
Updated `.idea/workspace.xml` to reflect changes in tracked blueprint files and task configurations.

Updated `.idea/workspace.xml` to track changes in blueprint files and highlight settings. Added new blueprint entries (`WBP_Aura_TextValueButtonRow`, `WBP_Aura_TextValueRow`) and updated task configurations.
Added `WBP_Aura_AttributeMenu` blueprint asset.
Marked `GetPlayerLevel` as `const` across relevant classes and interfaces to enforce immutability and improve code safety.
Removed unused magnitude parameter from `ApplyDefaultGameplayEffect` calls in `AuraBaseCharacter` to simplify method usage.
Simplified conditional blocks in `InitializeDefaultAttributes` to improve readability and maintain consistency.
Simplified conditional blocks in `AuraAttributeSet` by merging braces into single lines to improve readability and maintain consistency.
Refactored `AuraAttributeSet` by introducing helper methods to consolidate attribute clamping logic, improving readability and maintainability.
Added `WBP_Aura_Button` and `WBP_Aura_Button_AttributeMenu` blueprints, and updated existing blueprints (`WBP_Aura_AttributeMenu`, `WBP_Aura_TextValueButtonRow`, `WBP_Overlay`).
Expanded `AuraAttributeSet` with secondary attributes and improved gameplay attribute clamping logic. Updated `AuraTags` to include secondary attribute tags.
Reorganized `AuraTags` to move `Vital` tags beneath `Primary` and `Secondary` attributes for improved structure and consistency.
Added `AuraAttributeInfo` data asset to manage attribute metadata, updated `AuraAbilitySystemComponent` to include `AuraTags`.

Introduced `AuraAbilitySystemBPLibrary` with utility function to retrieve `AuraOverlayWidgetController`, added `AuraAttributeMenuWidgetController` class, and extended `AuraAttributeInfo` with default initialization logic.

Added `GetAttributeMenuWidgetController` blueprint function in `AuraAbilitySystemBPLibrary`, extended `AAuraHUD` with generic widget controller creation, and introduced `AuraAttributeMenuWidgetController` for attribute menu handling. Updated related blueprints.

Refactored `AuraAbilitySystemBPLibrary` to use a generic widget controller retrieval utility. Updated `AuraOverlayWidgetController` and `AuraAttributeMenuWidgetController` methods to leverage this abstraction. Enhanced `AuraAttributeMenuWidgetController` with `OnAttributeInfoChanged` delegate and related functionality.

Enhanced `AuraAttributeMenuWidgetController` with improved attribute change broadcasting via `AttributeInfoDelegate`. Updated `AuraAttributeInfo` to include `FGameplayAttribute` for streamlined data handling. Revised attribute-related blueprints and added delegate bindings in `AuraAttributeSet`.

Streamlined `AuraTags` with the addition of primary, secondary, and vital root tags for better gameplay tag organization. Improved `AuraAttributeInfo` with an editor utility to dynamically populate attributes from tags and revamped broadcast logic in `AuraAttributeMenuWidgetController` for more efficient attribute handling.

Refined `AuraAttributeInfo` to use distinct primary, secondary, and vital root tags for better tag filtering and organization. Optimized gameplay tag handling and streamlined attribute processing logic.

Updated `.idea/workspace.xml` and cleaned up IntelliJ project configuration. Refined `AuraMMC_Base.h` to improve code style by aligning brace formatting and standardized value initialization for clarity.
Just changed some settings.
Implemented startup ability for the base and character class.

Implement attribute tag assignment by row name in Attribute Menu
Implemented `SetAttributeTagsOnExistingRows` in `AuraAttributeMenuWidgetController`. This function allows mapping Attribute Tags to existing widget rows by matching the attribute name (derived from the tag) to the widget name (e.g., `Aura.Attributes.Primary.Strength` -> `Row_Strength`).
* **AuraAttributeMenuWidgetController**: Added `SetAttributeTagsOnExistingRows` to iterate attribute info and find matching widgets in the hierarchy. * **WBP_Aura_AttributeMenu**: Updated to utilize the new controller logic for initializing attribute rows. * **WBP_Aura_TextValueRow**: Updated blueprint asset.

Added `AuraInputConfig` for input action management and updated gameplay tags to support input configurations.
* **AuraInputConfig**: Introduced `UAuraInputConfig` class and `FAuraInputAction` struct for organizing input actions and tags. * **Gameplay Tags**: Added new input-related gameplay tags (e.g., LMB, RMB, numbers 1-4) for improved input handling. * **Blueprints**: Created input-related assets (e.g., `DA_Aura_InputConfig`, `IA_X` actions) for configuration management.

Added `AuraInputComponent` with ability action binding functionality
* **AuraInputComponent**: Introduced `UAuraInputComponent` extending `UEnhancedInputComponent`. Added `BindAbilityActions` template for mapping input actions from `AuraInputConfig` to ability functions. * **Input Handling**: Enabled binding of pressed, released, and held input events to associated gameplay actions.

Updated input action handling to support ability tags and introduced improved logging
* **Input Config**: Renamed `FindInputActionForTag` to `FindAbilityInputActionForTag` in `UAuraInputConfig` for clarity. * **Logging**: Improved error logging for unmatched ability input actions. * **Player Controller**: Updated `AAuraPlayerController` to use `UAuraInputComponent` for binding ability actions (`Pressed`, `Released`, `Held`). * **Core Enhancements**: Refactored `UAuraInputComponent` to simplify action binding logic.

Renamed `PopulateAttributeRows` to `PopulateVitalAttributeRows` in `AuraAttributeMenuWidgetController` for clarity. Updated function logic to filter by Vital attributes. Streamlined input action binding in `AuraInputComponent` and improved debug messages in `AuraPlayerController`.

Added support for input action handling based on gameplay tags
- **Gameplay Tags**: Introduced `Input` gameplay tag for categorizing input actions. - **AuraAbilitySystemComponent**: Added functions to handle input tags (`Held`, `Released`) and integrated startup input tags for abilities. - **Player Controller**: Implemented `GetASC` to retrieve the Ability System Component and route input actions. - **Code Enhancements**: Updated `AuraGameplayAbility`, `AuraInputConfig`, and relevant classes to improve input handling and ability mapping logic.

Refactored lambda bindings and optimized use of references for dynamic tags
- **AuraAttributeMenuWidgetController**: Updated lambda bindings to capture `FAttributeInfo` by value instead of reference for safer attribute broadcasting. - **AuraAbilitySystemComponent**: Modified `DynamicTags` usage to reference instead of copying for improved performance. - **Blueprint Updates**: Adjusted `BP_AuraCharacter` and `GA_Aura_Ability_Test` assets.
Updated `.idea/workspace.xml` to reflect recent file changes and cleaned up project task configurations. Adjusted `GA_Aura_Ability_Test` asset.

Updated `AuraAttributeMenuWidgetController` to use `UAuraUserWidget` instead of `UUserWidget` for row widgets and adjusted related functions for consistency. Deferred attribute initialization in `AuraPlayerCharacter` to ensure proper ASC setup.
Added `PostLoad` to `UAuraMMC_Base` to initialize capture definitions after property loading.
Enhanced `AAuraPlayerController` with spline component initialization, improved target highlighting logic, and added auto-run functionality with cursor-based movement input.
Added `NavigationSystem` dependency and improved cursor-based movement in `AAuraPlayerController` with pathfinding, spline updates, and auto-run functionality.
Added `AutoRun` functionality to `AAuraPlayerController` with spline-based navigation and updated `DefaultEngine.ini` for client-side navigation support.

Improved navigation handling in `AAuraPlayerController` by integrating custom collision channels, enhancing pathfinding accuracy with `NavMesh` projection, and updating the navigation query extent. Added `AuraCollisionChannels` for compile-time trace safety and adjusted `DefaultEngine.ini` to define custom collision profiles.

Refactored `AAuraPlayerController` to streamline input handling, improve cursor interaction, and enhance auto-run functionality. Centralized ability input logic, added helper functions for navigation, and updated actor highlighting for better readability and maintainability.
